title: Preserve external data during failed mutations

preflight.note: Registered before runtime changes on main 298828de6ae91f34dedd4f7cc6d98587f0959704 (tree 5fd33f98201f0ff313a199dc99ba74d0fb21ca8f). WI084 was the next canonical allocation; no competing WI084 reservation was found. PR15 and its dirty WI076 worktree/evidence were left untouched. Decision0040 governs stale-plan and transaction rollback semantics; the engine semantic-compatibility documentation mapping is an affected governance record.

acceptance_criteria.text: Incomplete or ambiguous preimage capture fails closed before the first mutation write; regression tests prove external bytes remain unchanged.

Capture complete, consistent, repository-contained preimages under the mutation lock; distinguish absent paths from unreadable, failed enumeration, unsupported type, symlink/reparse, and inconsistent state, and reject before writes.

Rollback changes only transaction-owned after-state, preserves external and unowned bytes/directories, reports conflicts as recovery-required failures, and never reports success or false rolled_back when restoration is unproven.

Focused regression coverage verifies create/edit/transition success; capture failures; injected failures before and after writes/moves; external drift before operation zero and during apply; subtrees, unrelated content, and symlink/reparse outside sentinels.

Run and record focused tests, the required local validation profile and legacy comparator, dashboard reconciliation, canonical validation, and frozen-surface check while preserving plan identity/read-set/lock/stale checks/postvalidation/proposal semantics. Do not claim process-death, power-loss, or arbitrary uncooperative-writer recovery.
